VERIFICATION_APPROVED.title: Your registration was approved
VERIFICATION_APPROVED.body: Your AIS Alumni membership has been approved.
VERIFICATION_APPROVED.detail: You can now use the directory, events, news and chat. Start by completing your profile.

VERIFICATION_REJECTED.title: Your registration wasn't approved
VERIFICATION_REJECTED.body: We checked your application but couldn't approve it this time.
VERIFICATION_REJECTED.detail: Please read the committee's note. If you think this is a mistake, contact the committee.

VERIFICATION_NEEDS_INFO.title: Please check your application
VERIFICATION_NEEDS_INFO.body: The committee has a question about your application.
VERIFICATION_NEEDS_INFO.detail: Read the note, update your application form and send it again.

SECURITY_METHOD_ADDED.title: A sign-in method was added
SECURITY_METHOD_ADDED.body: {method} sign-in was added to your account.
SECURITY_METHOD_ADDED.detail: If this wasn't you, check your settings right away and contact the committee.

SECURITY_METHOD_REMOVED.title: A sign-in method was removed
SECURITY_METHOD_REMOVED.body: {method} sign-in was removed from your account.
SECURITY_METHOD_REMOVED.detail: If this wasn't you, check your settings right away and contact the committee.

ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED_SELF.title: Your account was deactivated
ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED_SELF.detail: To come back, contact the committee. Thank you for being a member.

ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED.title: Your account was deactivated
ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED.detail: If you have questions, contact the committee.

ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED.title: Your account is active again
ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED.body: Your account can be used again.
ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED.detail: You can use the app as before.

NAME_REQUEST_REJECTED.title: Your name change wasn't approved
NAME_REQUEST_REJECTED.body: Your name change request wasn't approved.

BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_APPROVED.title: Your date of birth was updated
BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_APPROVED.body: Your date of birth change was approved.

BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_REJECTED.title: Your date of birth change wasn't approved
BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_REJECTED.body: Your date of birth request wasn't approved.

RECORD_REQUEST_APPROVED.title: Your record correction was approved
RECORD_REQUEST_APPROVED.body: Your AIS record has been corrected.

RECORD_REQUEST_REJECTED.title: Your record correction wasn't approved
RECORD_REQUEST_REJECTED.body: Your record correction request wasn't approved.

NEWS.title: New news from the committee
NEWS.body: The AIS Alumni Committee posted news.
NEWS.detail: Please open the app to read it.

NEWS_REMINDER.title: A response deadline is near
NEWS_REMINDER.body: There's a news post you haven't responded to yet.
NEWS_REMINDER.detail: Please check it and respond in the app before the deadline.

BROADCAST.title: A message from {from}
BROADCAST.detail: Please open the app to read it.

EVENT_REMINDER_7D.title: Event next week
EVENT_REMINDER_7D.detail: {place}You can change your RSVP in the app.

EVENT_REMINDER_1D.title: Event tomorrow
EVENT_REMINDER_1D.detail: {place}Show your QR ticket at the reception.

CHAT_MENTION.title: You were mentioned
CHAT_MENTION.detail: Please open the app to read it.

CHAT_DIGEST.title: You have unread chat messages
CHAT_DIGEST.body: You have {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}} in your group chats.
CHAT_DIGEST.detail: We send this at 8 pm only when there are unread messages. You can turn it off per group in the chat menu.

CHAT_GROUP.title: New message in a group
CHAT_GROUP.detail: Open the app to read it.

FOLLOW_REQUEST.title: New follow request
FOLLOW_REQUEST.detail: If you accept, they'll see what you share with followers.

FOLLOW_AUTO_ACCEPTED.title: You have a new follower
FOLLOW_AUTO_ACCEPTED.detail: Accepted automatically because you graduated around the same year. You can change this in settings.

FOLLOW_ACCEPTED.title: Your follow request was accepted
FOLLOW_ACCEPTED.detail: Take a look at their profile.

VOUCH_REQUEST.title: Do you know this person?
VOUCH_REQUEST.body: {name} applied to join and named you as someone who knows them.
VOUCH_REQUEST.detail: {years}Tell us with one tap whether you know them from AIS. Only the committee sees your answer.

FAMILY_LINK_REQUEST_AS_CHILD.title: Please confirm your family
FAMILY_LINK_REQUEST_AS_CHILD.detail: Accept or decline on the Family page.

FAMILY_LINK_REQUEST_AS_PARENT.title: Please confirm your family
FAMILY_LINK_REQUEST_AS_PARENT.detail: Accept or decline on the Family page.

FAMILY_HANDOVER_DONE.title: The account handover is complete
FAMILY_HANDOVER_DONE.detail: From now on your child signs in on their own. Your family link stays as it is.

STAGE_PROMPT.title: Update your education & work?
STAGE_PROMPT.body: A new school year has started. Your current status is “{stage}”.
STAGE_PROMPT.detail: If you've changed school or job, update your history so classmates can find you.

VERIFICATION_SUBMITTED_ADMIN.title: New membership application
VERIFICATION_SUBMITTED_ADMIN.detail: Review the application in admin mode.

NEWS_APPROVAL_ADMIN.title: News post awaiting approval
NEWS_APPROVAL_ADMIN.detail: Check it and approve it if it's fine. Members won't see it until it's approved.

EVENT_APPROVAL_ADMIN.title: Event awaiting approval
EVENT_APPROVAL_ADMIN.detail: Check it and approve it if it's fine. Members won't see it until it's approved.

BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_ADMIN.title: New date of birth request
BIRTH_DATE_REQUEST_ADMIN.body: {name} asked to add or correct their date of birth.

RECORD_REQUEST_ADMIN.title: New record correction request
RECORD_REQUEST_ADMIN.body: {name} asked to correct their AIS record.

GENDER_REQUEST_REJECTED.title: Your gender change wasn't approved
GENDER_REQUEST_REJECTED.body: Your gender change request wasn't approved.

CHAT_DIRECT.title: You have a new message
CHAT_DIRECT.detail: Open the app to read it.

categoryHints.account: Approval, security and the results of your requests. Can't be turned off.
categoryHints.events: A week and a day before events you're attending (by email)
categoryHints.chat: 1:1 messages and mentions (once, by LINE or email, if unread for 5 minutes) and group unread summaries (daily at 8 pm, by email)
categoryHints.social: Follow requests, acceptances and requests to vouch
categoryHints.profile: Yearly reminder to update your history

email.why: You got this email because of your “{category}” notifications.

receipts.title: Notification opens
receipts.hint: Members notified by LINE or email who opened the notification's link (members who read it in the app count under “Read”).
receipts.noneOpened: No one has opened it yet.
